canvas.title: The Line - Red
canvas.descriptionText:
Premium canvas art by Rebecca Hein high-quality 320 g cotton canvas with a textured matte finish. Mounted in a 3.5 cm deep frame made from FSC™-certified oak veneer or coloured wood veneer.
 "The Line - Red" art print distills Scandinavian minimalism into a sophisticated visual statement. Gestural red lines dance across a gentle beige canvas, evoking calm and clarity—an ideal focal point for the home office or living room, and harmonious with warm woods and muted interiors. The material details and subtle dimensionality invite close contemplation, enhancing curated contemporary spaces.
 Drawing inspiration from contemporary Scandinavian interiors, our framed canvas art prints combine tactile materials with a refined and timeless expression. The textured surface and floating frame design create depth, bringing selected artworks clearly into focus.
 Each canvas comes fully framed and ready to hang, with a discreet bracket on the back for easy wall mounting. Available only for selected artworks from our collection.
 Fade-resistant archival ink on matte cotton canvas
 Vibrant, true-to-life color reproduction
 Sustainably sourced materials and production
 Exclusively for The Poster Club

wall_object.title: Thalia Vase
wall_object.descriptionText:
Handcrafted in Aarhus, Denmark, by Katrine and Jacob Laoru, the Thalia Vase Relief draws inspiration from the Nine Greek Muses. In ancient Greece, both the vessel and the Muse were seen as bearers of life, inspiration and creative force. The vase has long been a symbol of womanhood, while the Muses, in Greek mythology, are divine daughters who embody inspiration and serve as the source of art, knowledge and creative expression.
>
> Thalia – Muse of Comedy
>
> Thalia is the Muse of comedy, traditionally associated with joy, lightness and vitality. In this ceramic relief, she represents playfulness and the uplifting spirit of humour. The idea of the Muse and the form of the vase come together – one giving shape to artistic thought, the other to its physical expression. Each piece is crafted by hand in glazed stoneware in nuanced tones of antique white and designed to be wall-mounted.
>
> Materials
> Glazed stoneware ceramic.
>
>
 Specifications
> Colour: Antique White
>Dimensions: Approx. H 28 × W 20 × D 1,5 cm.
>
> Mounting:
> The relief has a built-in hanging slot on the back that allows for wall mounting.
>
> Care & Maintenance
> Wipe with a dry or damp cloth to remove dust or dirt. The glazed surface is resistant to both frost and everyday smudges – no additional treatment needed.
>
>
